shortDescription: Manage Linode Domain Records. NOTE: Domain records are identified by their name, target, and type.

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the parent Domain.

options.name: domain_id
options.description: The ID of the parent Domain.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of this Record. NOTE: If the name of the record ends with the domain, it will be dropped from the resulting record's name. Unused for SRV record. Use the service property to set the service name for this record.

options.name: port
options.description: The port this Record points to. Only valid and required for SRV record requests.

options.name: priority
options.description: The priority of the target host for this Record. Lower values are preferred. Only valid for MX and SRV record requests. Required for SRV record requests.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol this Record’s service communicates with. An underscore (_) is prepended automatically to the submitted value for this property.

options.name: record_id
options.description: The id of the record to modify.

options.name: service
options.description: An underscore (_) is prepended and a period (.) is appended automatically to the submitted value for this property. Only valid and required for SRV record requests. The name of the service.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: tag
options.description: The tag portion of a CAA record. Only valid and required for CAA record requests.

options.name: ttl_sec
options.description: Time to Live - the amount of time in seconds that this Domain's records may be cached by resolvers or other domain servers. Valid values are 300, 3600, 7200, 14400, 28800, 57600, 86400, 172800, 345600, 604800, 1209600, and 2419200 - any other value will be rounded to the nearest valid value.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of Record this is in the DNS system.

options.name: weight
options.description: The relative weight of this Record used in the case of identical priority.
